id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Host-controller queue-pair architecture layered on PCI Express. Each NVMe controller is a PCI Function attached to the host's Root Complex via a PCIe link.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + single NVMe controller, single port
supported_topologies.description: Figure 3; M.2 SSD-style; PCI Function 0 = NVMe Controller.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + multi-Function NVMe subsystem
supported_topologies.description: Figure 4; PCI Function 0 + Function 1 with shared namespaces.

supported_topologies.name: Single host + multi-port multi-controller
supported_topologies.description: Figure 5; HA / dual-host / dual-port enterprise configurations.

supported_topologies.name: SR-IOV
supported_topologies.description: Figure 6; one PF + N VFs; Virtualization Management configures VF resources.

supported_topologies.name: NVMe over Fabrics
supported_topologies.description: Separate spec; same protocol over RDMA / TCP / FC.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Initiates commands; allocates queue rings + data buffers; consumes CQEs.
Executes commands; accesses host memory via PCIe TLPs; posts CQEs; asserts MSI-X.

fields.interconnect_role: PCIe Root Complex / Switch / Endpoint chain — addressing by (Bus, Device, Function). No NVMe-layer interconnect.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_command: PRP/SGL data buffer transfers complete before CQE write.
ordering_guarantees.across_commands: Commands fetched in order; executed and completed out-of-order; SQHD in CQEs communicates progress.
ordering_guarantees.doorbell_ordering: Successive SQyTDBL writes monotonically non-decreasing modulo queue size.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Namespace logical block address space is the storage region. Each namespace exposes 1..2^64 logical blocks of configured LBA size (typ 512 B or 4096 B). CMB / PMR optionally expose controller-local memory.

device_classification.boot_ssd: M.2 or U.2 with Boot Partitions support for UEFI-less boot.
device_classification.scm_pmem_device: Storage-Class Memory device with NVMe PMR.
device_classification.nvme_of_target: NVMe-oF target subsystem behind a fabric (RDMA/TCP/FC).
device_classification.host_or_initiator: Host SoC PCIe Root Complex driving one or more NVMe controllers.
